title: updateSpecFile
description: You must pass one of the accepted values in this request body. Also, this request body does not accept multiple properties in a single call. For example, you cannot pass both the `content` and `type` property at the same time.

type.description:
The type of file:
- `ROOT` — The file containing the full OpenAPI structure. This serves as the entry point for the API spec and references other (`DEFAULT`) spec files. Multi-file specs can only have one root file.
- `DEFAULT` — A file referenced by the `ROOT` file.
